name: Taiyou no Shita de Piero wa Kuchiru
original_name: 太陽の下でピエロは朽ちる
source:
I have a classmate named Natsuhi Sugimura.

Last year, we were in different classes, and we're not at all similar, so we weren't particularly close.

I didn't know anything about Sugimura.

Nothing. Not a single thing.

But Sugimura... hates me.

He despises me so much he wants to kill me.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/27041]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
我有一个叫杉村夏灯的同班同学。

去年我们不在同一个班，性格也截然不同，所以并没有多么亲近。

我对杉村一无所知。

什么都不知道。连一件事都不知道。

可是，杉村却……恨着我。

恨到想杀了我。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/27041]NovelGame[/url]]
